# cduyzh Mac Apps — Complete Catalog & Specifications

> Detailed documentation of native macOS utilities by cduyzh (Chengdu, Sichuan, China).

Author: cduyzh
Location: Chengdu, Sichuan, China
Portal: https://apps.cduyzh.top/
Chinese Portal: https://apps.cduyzh.top/zh.html
Sitemap: https://apps.cduyzh.top/sitemap.xml

---

## 1. iScreenshot (极速截屏)

- Categories: Screen Capture, Long Screenshot, Image Framing, Screen Recording
- Operating System: macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon & Intel)
- License: Free & Open Source
- English Home: https://apps.cduyzh.top/iScreenshot/
- Chinese Home: https://apps.cduyzh.top/iScreenshot/zh.html
- Features:
  - Smart window snapping and pixel-precise color loupe
  - Multi-feature aligned scrolling capture for long webpages and documents
  - Mockup canvas with customizable gradient backgrounds, padding, and soft drop shadows
  - Driver-free internal system audio recording powered by ScreenCaptureKit

---

## 2. iTrans (极译 AI)

- Categories: Translation, Menu Bar Utility, AI Productivity
- Operating System: macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon & Intel)
- License: Free (Bring Your Own API Key)
- English Home: https://apps.cduyzh.top/iTrans/
- Chinese Home: https://apps.cduyzh.top/iTrans/zh.html
- Features:
  - Global selection translation hotkeys (⌥E, ⌘C⌘C)
  - Direct official API connection for DeepSeek and Google Translate (no middleman server)
  - Local terminology memory saved on-device
  - Local Agent CLI and HTTP Gateway interface

---

## 3. Other Utilities in Portfolio

- ProcessLens: System resource monitoring without heavy dependencies
- DiskSweep: Duplicate & large file cleaning
- MenuBarTidy: Desktop clutter reduction
- WallpaperLoop: Dynamic live wallpapers
- MediaSaver: Media curation and Live Photo creation
- TouchFlow: Trackpad gestures and window manipulation
